description.value: Once operated as Riverside Liquor Store, this shop in Penticton's Riverside Village off Highway 97 was acquired in 2023 by Angry Otter Liquor, now one of BC's largest private liquor retailers operating under Otter Co-op. It is one of six Otter Co-op locations in Penticton and accepts co-op memberships offering cashback on purchases. Touring cyclists passing through on Highway 97 could stop for beverages, but the store offers no confirmed cycling-specific services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Riverside Liquor Store' but the website confirms it was acquired by Otter Co-op and rebranded 'Angry Otter Liquor @ Riverside' as of a March 2024 announcement (acquisition occurred in 2023). The website is entirely about the rebrand and co-op membership and contains no mention of cycling amenities, bike parking, water access, or washrooms. All required criteria and optional amenities must therefore be null.
concerns: OSM name 'Riverside Liquor Store' is outdated — the business was acquired in 2023 and rebranded 'Angry Otter Liquor @ Riverside' per the website's March 28, 2024 announcement.
No address or phone number present in OSM tags; neither appears in the fetched website content.
The discovered URL (riversideliquorstore.ca) now redirects to Otter Co-op content, suggesting the old domain was repurposed after the acquisition.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A liquor retail store with no confirmed required WWC criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms); it offers no meaningful cycling-specific services and is a weak fit for a cycling tourism directory.
